import (
	stdout from "@std/io/io.ms",
	Instant, monotonic from "@std/time.ms",
)

fn measure(start: Int) Int:
	t := monotonic()
	var i = start
	var hits = 0

	while i < 10000000:
		hits += i % 3
		i += 1

	elapsed := monotonic().difference(t).to_nanoseconds()
	line := "{start} {elapsed} {hits}\n"
	ignored := stdout().write(line.to_bytes())
	return hits

fn main() Unit:
	measure(-137)
	measure(0)
	measure(5)
